title: DSPy Base Modules
summary: This module defines the foundational building blocks for all DSPy programs: `BaseModule` provides core functionalities like parameter management and persistence, while `Module` extends it to enable program execution, LM interaction, and batch processing.

nodes.label: Base Module Foundation
nodes.title: dspy.primitives.base_module.BaseModule
nodes.description: Provides core functionalities for DSPy modules, including parameter management, deep copying, state saving/loading, and sub-module discovery.

nodes.label: DSPy Program Module
nodes.title: dspy.primitives.module.Module
nodes.description: The primary base class for all DSPy programs, extending BaseModule with execution logic, LM interaction, callback handling, and parallel processing capabilities.

nodes.label: Configurable Parameter
nodes.title: dspy.predict.parameter.Parameter
nodes.description: Represents a tunable or configurable element within a DSPy module, managed by BaseModule for state and optimization.

nodes.label: LM Prediction Component
nodes.title: dspy.predict.predict.Predict
nodes.description: A specialized module responsible for making calls to language models based on a defined signature, often composed within a DSPy Module.

nodes.label: Language Model Client
nodes.title: dspy.clients.base_lm.BaseLM
nodes.description: External service responsible for interacting with various language models, used by prediction components.

nodes.label: Serialization Utilities
nodes.title: cloudpickle, orjson
nodes.description: External libraries (like cloudpickle and orjson) used by BaseModule for saving and loading module states or entire programs.

nodes.label: Parallel Processing Engine
nodes.title: dspy.primitives.parallel.Parallel
nodes.description: Handles concurrent execution of multiple module calls for efficiency, utilized by the Module's batch method.

nodes.label: DSPy Global Settings
nodes.title: dspy.dsp.utils.settings
nodes.description: Manages global configurations, context, and usage tracking for DSPy programs, interacting with Module execution.

nodes.label: Event Callback System
nodes.title: dspy.utils.callback
nodes.description: Provides hooks for monitoring and instrumenting module execution, integrated into the Module's call process.

nodes.label: Module Prediction Output
nodes.title: dspy.Prediction
nodes.description: Standardized data structure representing the output of a DSPy module's execution, often including LM usage information.

nodes.label: Batch Example Data
nodes.title: dspy.Example
nodes.description: Input data format used for training or batch processing of modules, processed by the Module's batch method.

groups.label: Core Module Abstractions
groups.title: Core Module Abstractions
groups.description: Fundamental classes defining the structure and behavior of DSPy programs.

groups.label: Internal Module Components
groups.title: Internal Module Components
groups.description: Building blocks and specialized sub-modules used within DSPy programs.

groups.label: Runtime Management
groups.title: Runtime Management
groups.description: Utilities and systems that support the execution and monitoring of DSPy modules.

groups.label: Data Flow
groups.title: Data Flow
groups.description: Key data structures for inputs and outputs of DSPy modules.

groups.label: External Services
groups.title: External Services
groups.description: Integrations with external systems like language models and serialization tools.
